messages:
violet (release-coordinator): deploybot auto-paused the eu-west change window after the db throttle alert. holding non-urgent deploys for now.
omar (sre): confirmed high tail-latency and increased retries. good catch by deploybot.
deploybot: Paused 8 rollouts in env=eu-west. Reason=incident-2025-11-eu-db-throttle.
violet (release-coordinator): decision needed: rollback noisy canaries or pin and push remaining to next window?
tasia (platform): prefer pin + requeue. rolling back global set will cause cache-warm and spike downstream.
omar (sre): +1 pin. I'll create locks and set an emergency rollback trigger if metrics worsen.

# lock/pin canaries
releasectl pin --env eu-west --group '*' --reason "incident-2025-11-eu-db-throttle"
releasectl lock --env eu-west --policy rollback-on-spike --threshold error_rate=2.5

omar (sre): pins/locks applied id=pin-2025-11-81, lock=rb-901.
deploybot: Policy update: env=eu-west mode=hold, max-concurrent-promotions=0, emergency-rollback=enabled.
notify-bot: Alert: slowstore latency cleared at 2812345698 but some hosts still elevated.
tasia (platform): propose requeue non-urgent releases to next-window:morning-utc, allow emergency patches with two approvals (sre + platform).
violet (release-coordinator): approved. exception: authz-hotfix allowed manual patch path (requires omar + tasia signoff).
deploybot: Requeued 5 releases -> morning-utc. authz-hotfix flagged for manual expedited patch.
omar (sre): monitoring 40m; if error rate crosses threshold we flip to immediate rollback and freeze.
violet (release-coordinator): lena in product, please prepare a short blurb for CS and a status-page line if this remains >2hrs. will follow up with post-incident release schedule. :white_check_mark:
